title: Auto-renew and refund
body:
I’m one of the use who give this app a try and found it’s not for me during free trial period  
I heard that some of the users was charged $50 for 1 year premium membership after the free trial period is over, without any notification, even a single message to ask for permission, because the fabulous will renew your membership automatically. Please manually cancel your subscription by the end of your free trial period if you do not intend to use it any further.  
If you are an iOS user and get charged accidentally, you could try to request a refund via apple report. I personally found the undesired payment more than 15 days after I was charged, and I claim my money back in 24 hours, just FYI 
 
For the development team, I’m not sure whether the app is fabulous or not, but the auto renew issue is definitely what you should work on to make it better, and it’s pretty basic
